skill.name: AgentDB Memory Patterns
skill.description: Implement persistent memory patterns for AI agents with AgentDB, including session memory, long-term storage, pattern learning, and context retrieval.
skill.summary: Build persistent AgentDB memory patterns for stateful AI agents.
skill.author: ruvnet

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown fences, inline command text, documentation links, or local example paths, not executable code. Contextual risks remain from unpinned AgentDB commands and persistent memory storage without clear privacy guardrails.

remediation.suggestion: Pin AgentDB versions, verify package provenance, and require user confirmation before running npx or MCP setup commands.
Explain what permissions the MCP server needs and document a remove or rollback command.
Add consent, redaction, encryption, retention, and deletion guidance for stored conversations and user facts.
Warn that backups and migrated databases may contain user data, and require secure storage and access controls.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Package Execution and MCP Setup
semantic_findings.description: The skill recommends npx agentdb@latest commands and a Claude Code MCP registration. Running latest remote packages and installing an MCP server can execute unreviewed code and expand tool access.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The commands explicitly use npx agentdb@latest and add an MCP server. This is legitimate setup guidance, but it carries clear supply-chain and tool-installation risk without pinning or confirmation requirements.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Memory Privacy Controls Missing
semantic_findings.description: The examples store conversation content, user preferences, and learned patterns in persistent databases. The skill does not provide consent, redaction, retention, encryption, or deletion guidance for this memory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited examples intentionally store user-facing conversation and preference data, then describe export and migration paths. I found no matching privacy or retention guidance in the skill text.

content.user_title: Build AgentDB Memory for AI Agents
content.value_statement: Stateful agents need reliable memory across sessions. This skill shows AgentDB patterns for storing messages, facts, learned patterns, and retrieved context.
actual_capabilities: Shows AgentDB initialization commands for local vector databases.
Demonstrates session memory storage and history retrieval patterns.
Explains long-term fact storage for user preferences and agent context.
Provides pattern learning examples for successful interaction reuse.
Covers ReasoningBank migration and AgentDB adapter setup.
Lists CLI operations for query, import, export, stats, benchmarks, and plugins.
limitations: Does not include runnable project files or automated tests.
Relies on external AgentDB packages and their installed behavior.
Does not define privacy policies for stored user memory.
Performance claims come from the skill text and are not independently verified.

use_cases.title: Add chat memory
use_cases.description: Use session and long-term memory patterns to preserve context between conversations.

use_cases.title: Migrate ReasoningBank data
use_cases.description: Follow the adapter and migration examples to move legacy memory stores into AgentDB.

use_cases.title: Prototype learning agents
use_cases.description: Use pattern learning and plugin examples to test memory-assisted agent behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Map a basic memory store
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the AgentDB Memory Patterns skill, outline a simple session memory design for a chat agent. Include stored fields and retrieval flow.

prompt_templates.title: Add long-term facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design long-term fact storage for user preferences. Include confidence, source tracking, and update rules.

prompt_templates.title: Plan ReasoningBank migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a migration from ReasoningBank to AgentDB. Include data validation, rollback, and testing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review memory safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit an AgentDB memory design for privacy, retention, export, and command execution risks. Recommend mitigations.

output_examples.input: I need a memory plan for a support chatbot.
output: Session memory stores recent turns with timestamps.
Long-term facts store stable preferences with confidence values.
Retrieval uses the current query plus session filters.

output_examples.input: Help me migrate legacy ReasoningBank data.
output: Inventory source databases and backup files first.
Run migration in a staging environment before production.
Compare counts, sample records, and retrieval quality after migration.

output_examples.input: Review my agent memory design for risk.
output: Require approval before running external package commands.
Avoid storing raw sensitive conversation content.
Protect exports and define deletion rules for stored memory.

best_practices: Pin AgentDB package versions before running setup or MCP commands.
Store only necessary user memory and define retention rules before launch.
Validate exports, migrations, and plugin changes in a test database first.
anti_patterns: Running latest package commands automatically without human confirmation.
Saving raw conversation data without consent, redaction, or deletion controls.
Treating benchmark claims as production results without local testing.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design AgentDB memory patterns for stateful AI agents and chat systems.

faq.question: Does it install AgentDB for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and examples that a user or agent may run after review.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an MCP server setup example for Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it store sensitive data?
faq.answer: It can store conversation memory and user facts. Review privacy controls before using it with real users.

faq.question: Does it include a full application?
faq.answer: No. It is a pattern guide with CLI and TypeScript examples.

faq.question: What should I verify before production?
faq.answer: Verify package versions, memory retention, backups, exports, and migration accuracy.
